original_card.one_sentence_claim: SBT's proved duality-confinement membrane theorem (MasterTheorem.masterTheorem) converts, for any involutive ledger with separating anti-invariant readout and a trace-vanishing domination sequence, the budget A_X<=B_n with trace B_n -> 0 into confinement of visible mass to the fixed locus Fix(J); instantiating J as the CPT operation yields a STRUCTURAL PREDICTION (not a theorem) that a CPT-genuine formed layer cannot retain visible CPT-odd mass once domination records are supplied.
original_card.target_known_fact: The CPT theorem (Lueders-Pauli; Streater-Wightman): a Lorentz-invariant local quantum field theory with the spin-statistics connection is invariant under the antiunitary CPT operation, so observable physics is confined to the CPT-invariant sector. The same template targets charge conjugation C (particle-antiparticle / self-conjugate fixed locus), self-adjointness (reality of self-adjoint spectra under Hermitian conjugation), and unbroken PT-symmetric Hamiltonians with real spectra (Bender-Boettcher 1998).
original_card.scientific_domain: Quantum field theory / particle physics: discrete spacetime/internal symmetries (CPT, C, PT, self-adjointness) reframed as confinement to a duality fixed locus under an involutive ledger.
original_card.argument_family: symmetry-emergence (fixed-locus confinement of an anti-invariant obstruction under an involutive self-duality + vanishing trace budget)

Produce a fully worked, Lean-checked single-substrate validation of the master theorem on a substrate where the involution, separating readout, and a CONSTRUCTED (not opaque) trace-vanishing domination sequence are all explicit and elementary -- e.g. the transpose involution on Mat_n(R) (Frobenius skew readout, fixed locus Sym_n) or the finite Hermitian-symmetric DTFT instantiation from F14. This demonstrates the engine end-to-end with no opaque recognition source, exactly recovering an elementary fixed-locus fact, and is honestly labeled as engine validation, not a physics retrodiction.
original_card.baseline_comparison: RECOVERY (and weaker than recovery, for CPT specifically): SBT does NOT do better than, and does not even independently reproduce, the standard CPT account. The standard CPT theorem DERIVES CPT invariance from Lorentz invariance + locality + spin-statistics. SBT's master theorem assumes a genuine CPT involution and a vanishing CPT-odd budget already exist, then mechanically converts them into confinement -- i.e. it reorganizes/relabels an assumed symmetry. What is genuinely reorganized is the SHARED SHAPE across discrete symmetries (CPT, C, PT, self-adjointness, Galois, Smith theory): one uniform 'confinement to a fixed locus under involution + vanishing anti-invariant trace budget' law. The proved master theorem is a typed-cone abstraction of an elementary classical fact (a positive trace-class operator dominated by traces tending to zero is zero); the paper explicitly claims no novelty for the underlying operator theory.
original_card.honest_status_note: NOT a theorem of SBT and NOT a derivation of the CPT theorem. SDTC sec:scope/sec:discussion states CPT/gauge/C are 'structural predictions and validation targets for future work, not theorems established here' and 'a pointer toward the shape of a validation problem, not a derivation of CPT invariance.' What IS proved and Lean-certified is only the apparatus/master theorem at the typed positive-cone level. For CPT, all three load-bearing hypotheses are externally supplied. Correctly tagged grounded=false, derivability_class D.

opposite_world_test.explanation: In a CPT-violating world the template accommodates equally: withholding/failing to supply the opaque domination sequence makes the master theorem's hypothesis fail and it concludes nothing -- visible CPT-odd mass is allowed. To 'predict' confinement, declare J=CPT, assert a separating readout, and supply a trace-vanishing B_n. SBT has no internal machinery deciding which world obtains: it does not derive J=CPT, does not prove separation, has no constructor for B_n. The one mild guard is monotonicity -- the engine cannot manufacture confinement WITHOUT a vanishing-trace input, so it cannot fake confinement out of nothing -- but it also cannot rule the opposite world out, and supplying the input is unconstrained.
